BiblicalUsage: Peraziy means unwalled, of the open country. The cities of Og were fenced with high walls and gates, beside unwalled towns a great many, and the Jews of the villages kept the fourteenth of Adar with gladness.
TheologicalSignificance: What I believe is that walls do not make a people safe: the unwalled towns feasted, and the fenced cities fell.
